messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 P0 — Elevated 5xx error rate on inference cluster us-west-2 (dedicated) affecting customer: Nimbus Financial (dedicated-pool-nimbus)
sanjay: I'm oncall, taking lead. digging into logs now. any immediate mitigation suggestions? :mag_right:
darren: saw a sharp spike ~1765432050, memory pressure on pod gk-infer-12. not sure if autoscaler dipped. grabbing metrics.
linh: logging shows KV cache errors + repeated OOM kills. suspect quantized model worker regression after last rollout. rolling back to v1.3.2 hotfix?
emily-cs: customer success check-in — Nimbus has active SLAs, AMs need to be looped. Jordan (AM) FYI.
jordan-am: here. prepare a short external note I can send to Nimbus leadership. they want ETA and impacted routes.
sanjay: immediate plan: 1) stop canary workers (v1.4.x) 2) scale up fallback pool (v1.3.2) 3) restart affected pods with safe mem flags. executing now.
ops-rotation: runbook step 4: if errors persist, failover traffic to region us-east-1. notify infra for cross-region routing.
sanjay: running commands:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/gk-infer gk-worker=redwood/gk-worker:v1.3.2 --record
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/gk-infer
```
linh: rollback initiated, watching pod churn. memory usage stabilizing on newly deployed workers.
darren: early signs of 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 1.5% over last 3m. still monitoring latency tail.
emily-cs: Nimbus contacts to notify:
- Primary: carla@nimbusfin.com (VP Ops)
- Secondary: ops-oncall@nimbusfin.com
- Exec: ceo@nimbusfin.com (for >60 min outage only)
Please route initial heads-up to primary + ops-oncall.
jordan-am: draft external blurb for Nimbus (short):
"Hi Carla — we detected elevated inference errors impacting a subset of requests for your dedicated pool. Our engineering team has rolled back a recent worker release and is observing recovery. We expect full restoration in <30 mins. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary and mitigation steps. — Jordan, AM"
emily-cs: status page snippet for public-facing status (short):
"Investigating: Increased error rates for dedicated inference in us-west-2 impacting select enterprise customers. Engineers are rolling back recent rollout and mitigating. No action required for most customers. Updates every 15 minutes."
sanjay: internal impact summary for ops channel (one-liner):
"Impact: ~12% of Nimbus traffic experienced 5xx responses between 1765432050-1765432350; degraded for customer-specific dedicated pool. Recovery in progress after rollback to v1.3.2."
linh: FYI logs show a specific OOM trace, added to ticket INF-4872. linking to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-oom
emily-cs: suggested tailored customer email (long):
"Hi Carla / Nimbus team,\n\nWe identified an elevated error rate for your dedicated inference pool in us-west-2 starting at 12:40 UTC. Our engineers rolled back a recent worker release and applied memory safeguards; error rates are returning to normal. We estimate full restoration within 30 minutes. We understand the impact on your production traffic and will provide a detailed incident report including root cause and preventive actions within 4 business hours.\n\nIf you'd like an immediate call, please share availability and we'll set one up.\n\n— Jordan / Redwood Inference\n"
sanjay: monitoring SLA metrics and preparing to ACK to incident manager. current mitigation looks effective, keeping this thread active for communication handoff.
ops-rotation: paging escalation matrix for this customer (use for follow-ups):
- 0-15m: oncall eng (sanjay)
- 15-45m: eng lead (darren)
- >45m: escalation to SRE manager + AM oncall
emily-cs: routing note for internal comms: CSM should send the tailored email to Primary + ops-oncall; AM should be on copy. If there is a customer-facing status page entry, link it in the email.
sanjay: last check 5xx at 0.5% in last 4m. leaving in monitoring state. will hand off to Darren in 20m for postmortem and RCA.
darren: will take the handoff at 1765433200. prepping an RCA checklist and timeline. assigning INF-4872 owner and tagging for postmortem.
incident-bot: incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. assigned_to: darren. :white_check_mark:
